title: Editor E4 remainder: put the canvas on the live channel and build the RSC parity harness
detail:
Split from PROG-E4B on 2026-11-10. /pages/canvas edits a page-local Y.Doc. Still owed: the canvas joins lib/editor-crdt/provider for a real entity so two browsers converge on one page, and the RSC-canvas parity harness. Dark.

Closed 2026-11-10: /pages/canvas?space=<id> joins the Space's private editing channel through the editor-crdt provider (CollabCanvas), the same room and authorization as the Space page builder. Text rides the doc's own `text` map and is not persisted. The RSC parity harness moved to PROG-E4D. Entity choice: the Space, because the channel policy already authorizes it and a Pages record would need a migration.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const d="components/builder/canvas";const ok=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>/\.tsx$/.test(f)&&!/\.test\./.test(f)).some(f=>/editor-crdt\/provider/.test(fs.readFileSync(d+"/"+f,"utf8")));if(!ok){console.error("PROG-E4C: no canvas component joins the live channel (lib/editor-crdt/provider)");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main: the canvas uses a page-local doc. Passes once a canvas component connects through lib/editor-crdt/provider.
